title: Lp Reviewer Review Output
description: Output of the *review task (Hawk). The multi-dimensional review report and verdict.

reviewReport.description: review-report.md — verdict (APPROVE / NEEDS_FIXES / MAJOR_ISSUES), issue counts by severity (critical/major/minor/suggestion), each issue with location + problem + proposed fix, and dimension scores (Copy, Design, Code, Conversion, Overall out of 10). Reviews all four dimensions every time. Any critical issue or missing core section forces MAJOR_ISSUES.
